# Pinoy Mobile Mechanic

> Mobile auto repair in San Diego County, California. Pinoy Mobile Mechanic LLC is based in Mira Mesa (92126) and fixes cars at the customer's home or work lot anywhere within 50 miles: San Diego, Poway, Escondido, San Marcos, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Vista, Encinitas, Del Mar, La Mesa, El Cajon, Santee, Chula Vista, National City and nearby.

- Services: hybrid service and repair, brakes, oil changes and fluids, diagnostics (check engine light, electrical, no-start, warning lights), A/C service, starters, alternators, belts, suspension, tune-ups.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific. Closed Sunday.
- Phone and text: 858-933-7045. Book online: https://calendar.app.google/mxYcWMjDeqJaWwGKA
- Licensed by the California Bureau of Automotive Repair, ARD 315968. Customers get a written quote before any work starts.
- Starting prices (most cars): Mobile diagnostic / check engine light $99; No-start diagnosis $99; Synthetic oil change $89; Battery replacement $199; Battery install only $59; Brake pads $199; Brake pads and rotors $329; Brake fluid flush $119; Alternator replacement $399; Starter replacement $349; Spark plugs / tune-up $179; Serpentine belt $149; Thermostat $199; Water pump $399; Radiator replacement $449; Pre-purchase inspection $149; A/C recharge $149; Any other job $130/hour + parts. No trip fee within 25 miles of Mira Mesa; $25 to $50 beyond that, up to 50 miles. The diagnostic fee is credited toward the repair if you book it. Warranty: 12 months / 12,000 miles on parts and labor. Customer-supplied parts get labor only.
